metadata.description: Structured homepage content for MedOrbits, covering education discovery, admission guidance, career development, recruitment resources, international education and application preparation.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify admission rules, eligibility criteria, entrance examinations, counselling procedures, fees, scholarships, employment opportunities, application deadlines, visa requirements and regulatory information with the relevant official institution, employer, examination authority, regulator or government source before relying on or publishing time-sensitive claims.

dataPolicy.externalClaims: Do not present unverified eligibility, admission, employment, financial or regulatory information as confirmed.
dataPolicy.availability: Do not imply that a course, vacancy, scholarship, service or application is currently available unless its availability has been verified.
dataPolicy.outcomes: Do not guarantee admission, employment, recruitment, visa approval, scholarships or other outcomes.
dataPolicy.navigation: All internal destinations must be verified against the deployed website structure.
dataPolicy.images: Use approved image assets whose filenames match the configured homepage image directory.
dataPolicy.accessibility: Use concise headings, descriptive text, meaningful link labels and appropriate image alternative text.

sections.title: Start with a plan.
sections.description: Turn your education or career ambitions into a practical plan. Explore relevant information, compare available pathways, understand the requirements and identify next steps that align with your qualifications, priorities, budget and circumstances.

cards.title: Define your goals
cards.description: Clarify your interests, qualifications, budget, preferred destinations and priorities before selecting an education or career pathway.

cards.title: Explore your options
cards.description: Compare courses, colleges, universities, study destinations and professional opportunities using relevant information and official resources.

cards.title: Prepare your applications
cards.description: Organise application documents, review eligibility criteria, understand procedural requirements and track relevant deadlines using official sources.

cards.title: Take your next step
cards.description: Compare alternatives, identify practical actions and organise your next steps with a clearer understanding of the available information and requirements.

sections.title: Support built around
sections.description: Explore education resources, admission information, career opportunities and international study pathways. Use relevant information and official sources to assess your options and plan your next move.

cards.title: Education discovery
cards.description: Discover courses, colleges, universities, scholarships and educational resources to compare study pathways, understand entry requirements and identify relevant opportunities.

cards.title: Admission guidance
cards.description: Understand admission procedures, eligibility criteria, entrance examinations, counselling processes and documentation requirements using current information from the relevant authorities.

cards.title: Career opportunities
cards.description: Explore employment opportunities, internships, career-development resources, recruitment services and employer-focused support to identify relevant professional pathways.

cards.title: Study abroad
cards.description: Compare international study destinations, programmes, admission requirements and documentation. Consult the relevant official institutions and government authorities for current visa and regulatory requirements.

sections.title: From preparation to
sections.description: Explore job discovery, application preparation, recruitment resources and career guidance to support informed professional decisions. Review each opportunity's eligibility criteria, responsibilities and application requirements before applying.

cards.title: Discover opportunities
cards.description: Search for job and internship opportunities by industry, location, qualifications, experience and role requirements.

cards.title: Prepare your applications
cards.description: Organise your educational background, work experience, skills, CV or résumé and supporting documents for relevant employment and professional applications.

cards.title: Recruitment services
cards.description: Explore recruitment support, candidate discovery and employer resources designed to help organisations assess workforce needs and plan their hiring activities.

cards.title: Plan your career
cards.description: Explore professional pathways, qualification requirements, transferable skills and development options relevant to your interests and long-term career objectives.

sections.title: Four steps to
sections.description: Move from an initial idea to an informed next step through a straightforward process: define your goal, explore relevant pathways, verify requirements and organise your actions.

cards.title: Share your goals
cards.description: Describe your education or career interests, current circumstances and priorities through the MedOrbits enquiry form.

cards.title: Explore pathways
cards.description: Compare relevant courses, institutions, study destinations and career opportunities against your interests, qualifications and practical requirements.

cards.title: Verify requirements
cards.description: Check eligibility criteria, required documents, application procedures, deadlines and applicable fees against the latest information published by the relevant official authorities.

cards.title: Plan your next move
cards.description: Turn your research into a practical action plan, identify the next steps and request additional guidance where appropriate.
